t: A pocket sensor lab with a color screen and Bluetooth.
steps: Buy the board from Adafruit for about 45 US dollars or from a maker store.
Get a micro USB cable that carries data.
Download the CircuitPython file for the CLUE from the CircuitPython website.
Double press the reset button to open the board drive. Drag the file onto it.
Install the free Mu editor on your computer.
Copy the Adafruit CLUE library onto the board drive.
Try the sensor demo from the Adafruit Learn guide to see readings on the screen.
Move on to the step counter example next.
meta: Open Board. From $44.95. A few stores.
